stem:
In an experiment, two plants are grown together for a time and then separated. Plant 2 is a parasite of Plant 1.

Which graph best predicts the growth of Plant 1 and Plant 2 during the experiment?

options.label: A
options.text: (Graph showing Plant 1 mass increasing constantly, Plant 2 mass increasing slowly together, then both continue increasing after separated)

options.label: B
options.text: (Graph showing Plant 1 and Plant 2 mass increasing together then both decreasing after separated)

options.label: C
options.text: (Graph showing Plant 1 mass increasing steadily, Plant 2 mass increasing then sharply decreasing after separated)

options.label: D
options.text: (Graph showing Plant 1 and Plant 2 mass increasing together, both increase more steeply after separated)

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled A, B, C, D each with two lines labeled Plant 1 (solid) and Plant 2 (dashed). X axis labeled Time with points Together and Separated. Y axis labeled Plant Mass.
notes: Graphs described rather than depicted in JSON text to preserve exact math and wording as requested.
